name: Google News RSS
tagline: Unofficial free RSS feeds for Google News top stories, topics, and keyword search
description: Google News exposes public RSS endpoints at news.google.com/rss that return aggregated headlines as standard RSS XML. There is no official Google News developer API; the old Google News Search API was discontinued years ago. These RSS URLs require no API key or account and are community-documented rather than officially supported. Feeds cover top stories, topic sections, geo locations, and keyword search (up to ~100 items per request). Google can change formats without notice.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public HTTP GET to news.google.com/rss endpoints; no API key or account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free unrestricted public RSS; no published quota. Unofficial; heavy use may get IP throttling/blocks.

rate_limits: not published (unofficial RSS; community reports soft IP throttling/CAPTCHAs under heavy load)

example.response_snippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0">
  <channel>
    <title>"artificial intelligence" - Google News</title>
    <link>https://news.google.com/search?q=artificial+intelligence&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en</link>
    <description>Google News</description>
    <item>
      <title>Article headline - Source Name</title>
      <link>https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi...</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">CBMi...</guid>
      <pubDate>Fri, 07 Aug 2026 12:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <description><a href="...">Source</a>  <font>Article snippet...</font></description>
      <source url="https://example.com">Source Name</source>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

use_cases: get top Google News headlines for a country/locale
search recent news articles by keyword via RSS
fetch topic headlines (e.g. TECHNOLOGY, BUSINESS, WORLD)
monitor news for a company or brand with when: date filters
pull geo-local news headlines for a city or region
